# ChartGenie.xyz — Chart Maker

> ChartGenie makes charts from values you enter or paste. Export PNG at 1x, 2x, or 4x pixel scale, or export SVG from the displayed chart.

## Key Capabilities & Features
- **Smart Parser**: Preview label and value pairs from plain text and confirm the rows before use.
- **Multi-Format Aspect Ratios**: Instant framing for 16:9 (Landscape / Slide), 1:1 (Square / Feed), 9:16 (Vertical Story / Reels), and 4:3 (Deck).
- **Aesthetic Themes & Modes**: 12 handcrafted color palettes (Apple, Linear, Midnight, Emerald, Sunset, Neon Cyber, Berry, Warm Amber, Pastel, Slate, etc.) and 6 canvas modes (Light, Dark, Spotify Wrapped, Paper Texture, True OLED, Slate).
- **Export**: PNG at 1x, 2x, or 4x pixel scale, SVG, and clipboard copy. SVG may contain embedded raster content.
- **Local saves**: Charts saved to My Charts use this browser's local storage. Site analytics excludes chart titles, labels, values, and prompt text.
- **Interactive Data Table**: Reorder, duplicate, color-pick, and toggle individual series or import CSV/TSV spreadsheets.

## Direct Links & Routes
- Main Web Studio: https://chartgenie.xyz/
- Pie Chart Maker: https://chartgenie.xyz/pie-chart-maker
- Bar Graph Generator: https://chartgenie.xyz/bar-graph-maker
